name: paint_colors
label: Paint color names
provenance: Wave-1 WS-1 batch 1, added 2026-07-24 on branch claude/next-three-items-nj7dyj. Real and invented paint color names in the style of major manufacturers, ranging from descriptive (Alabaster, Apricot) to poetic (Aurora Red, Crystal Clear); recalled from general knowledge, not taken from any manufacturer fan deck, so some entries are plausible rather than real. Homage to Janelle Shane's original neural-network paint-color project. Distinct from data/paint_colors.tsv (the WS-4 dual-output demo, CSS keyword names + luminance) - same stem, different dataset, which is why that file's sidecar is paint_colors_tsv.meta.json. One line, 'Bells & Whistles', carries an ampersand and is grandfathered in scripts/check_data.py.
